segments.text: V. 42. Thus much for your Behaviour towards the Violent. As for thoſe who uſe milder Methods, Give to him that aſketh thee—Give and lend to any ſo far (but no farther, for GOD never contradicts Himſelf) as is conſiſtent with thy Engagements to thy Creditors, thy Family and the Houſhold of Faith.
